posts.title: The language of perception in Siwu
posts.description: In which I highlight some findings on the language of perception in Siwu, a language of eastern Ghana, as described in a chapter in an eternally forthcoming edited volume. Studying the language of perception shows the deep entanglements of the sensory and social worlds we inhabit.

posts.title: Manufacturing consensus: two pivotal moments for OSI and its open source AI definition
posts.description: In 2023, the Open Source Initiative (OSI) started to develop efforts towards defining open source AI. In October 2024, OSI presented version 1 of their proposed Open Source AI Definition, but it was immediately controversial. This post records two pivotal moments I observed in the OSI discussion forums surrounding this controversy.

posts.title: On depersonifying oneself
posts.description: Sam Altman wrote: "I am a stochastic parrot". Bateson comments (in 1979): "The mountain, personified in our speech, will not become a person, will not learn a more personal way of being. But the human being, depersonified in his own talk, and thought, may indeed learn more thingish habits of action."
